takenRequests.title: Three strength sessions
takenRequests.description: Complete three strength sessions with recovery days. Record the exercises and repetitions.

takenRequests.title: Networking field assignment
takenRequests.description: Complete three focused practice sessions. Design and validate a small switched and routed network, including addressing, VLANs, security, and documentation.

takenRequests.title: Teach a difficult topic
takenRequests.description: Prepare and check your material on separate days before the final recording. Prepare and record a sourced explanation of a difficult topic. Answer five likely questions and check your answers against original sources.

takenRequests.title: Group hike
takenRequests.description: Complete a planned 60–90 minute hike with companions. Keep a sustainable pace, share navigation decisions, and check that the route suits the group.

takenRequests.title: Warrior commission
takenRequests.description: Complete individual practice toward this class goal: Build muscular strength with bodyweight exercises or weights. Use a recording, simulation, or checked example to demonstrate a correction or application; choose the next progression.

takenRequests.title: Warrior training adventure
takenRequests.description: Build a sustainable month of warrior practice. Complete each milestone before claiming the adventure.

takenRequests.title: Portfolio project
takenRequests.description: Build a short analysis with a clean dataset, findings, and a stakeholder-ready summary. Save the finished work and a short review.

takenRequests.title: Brisk walk for 30 minutes
takenRequests.description: Walk at a pace where conversation is possible but singing is difficult. Include an easy warm-up and cool-down.

takenRequests.title: Apply a concept
takenRequests.description: Study a concept and solve a new problem or build a working example without copying the solution. Verify the result.

takenRequests.title: Bible chapter study
takenRequests.description: Study a chapter with its historical and literary context. Explain its main teaching and distinguish it from a personal inference.

takenRequests.title: Solo presentation rehearsal
takenRequests.description: Rehearse and record a ten-minute presentation alone. Use a clarity and structure checklist to revise the weakest section.

takenRequests.title: Targeted job application
takenRequests.description: Independently tailor and submit one relevant job application, or improve a portfolio work sample against a target role's requirements.

takenRequests.title: Networking practice
takenRequests.description: Work independently on Networking using a written case, simulation, or practical exercise. Check the result against a source or marking guide and record one correction.

takenRequests.title: Floor pushups · 3 × 20
takenRequests.description: Complete three sets of twenty full-range floor pushups with controlled form and adequate rest. Build to this volume gradually.

takenRequests.title: Complete a 5 km run
takenRequests.description: Complete five kilometres at a sustainable pace after a progressive run/walk buildup.
